meta.purpose: Establecer el estado actual del corpus WEB_HITERATION distinguiendo componentes existentes, diseñados, propuestos, referenciados, ejecutados y realmente validados.
meta.scope: Corpus y evidencia disponibles en la ventana de trabajo y en el inventario del repositorio.

E1_E10_DEVELOPMENT_PHASE.purpose: Convert methodological requirements identified by the meta-audit into an executable and auditable evidence pipeline.

E01.name: COMMON_TAXONOMY
E01.purpose: Use identical R1-R7 definitions across compared execution conditions.

E02.name: FUNCTIONALLY_EQUIVALENT_STIMULI
E02.purpose: Ensure that compared platforms receive equivalent experimental stimuli.

E04.name: RAW_OUTPUT_PRESERVATION
E04.purpose: Preserve original outputs without retrospective modification.

E05.name: INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION
E05.purpose: Prevent the evaluated executor from being the sole validator of its own result.

E07.name: METRIC_DERIVATION
E07.purpose: Define exact formulas, inputs, normalization and units for all reported metrics.

E08.name: INDEPENDENT_RECALCULATION
E08.purpose: Recalculate reported metrics from preserved raw data.

E09.name: ABLATION
E09.purpose: Separate effects attributable to taxonomy, WH structure and combined intervention.

E10.name: EXPLICIT_REFUTATION
E10.purpose: Actively seek conditions under which the expected functional effect disappears.

L0_DECLARATION.meaning: Concepts, hypotheses and protocol definitions exist as documents.

L1_FORMALIZATION.meaning: Core invariants, taxonomy and several operational protocols have been formalized.

L2_EXECUTION_DESIGN.meaning: Benchmark and validation architectures have been designed.

L3_OBJECTIVE_EXECUTION.meaning: Some benchmark executions exist, but they are not yet sufficient for matched replicated causal inference.

KNOWN_EVIDENCE_PROBLEMS.issue: Image generation manifests described execution without independently verifiable artifact evidence
P_DRIFT remains formulated but not empirically calibrated

R5_EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.supported_interpretation: An operation can be representable or describable while the mechanism, tool, permission, channel or resource required for actual execution is unavailable in the evaluated condition.
R5_EXECUTION_BOUNDARY.routing_implication: Restriction classification can inform external orchestration decisions.

CRITICAL_GAPS.issue: La formulación 'La memoria no se conserva. Se reconstruye.' excedía la frontera epistemológica.
P1, P3, P5, sigma, HR e IE requieren reglas operacionales explícitas.
La arquitectura de evidencia todavía no se ha convertido en preregistro ejecutable.
Residuos JSON detectados y corregidos parcialmente. Auditoría externa 2026-09-26 confirmó correcciones.

positive: La arquitectura conceptual principal está considerablemente formalizada.
La separación entre representación y ejecución está mejor definida.
R1-R7 puede utilizarse como taxonomía de restricciones observables.
La necesidad de evaluación independiente está incorporada al diseño.
E1-E10 proporciona una arquitectura plausible para cerrar la brecha entre diseño y evidencia.
not_yet_demonstrated: validación independiente de todas las métricas
